latHint: Think a snow globe being shaken.
pivHint: God tells us to be STILL and know that he is God. In Mark's Gospel, Jesus commanded the wind and waves to be STILL during a ______.
winText: You found it. STILL isn't just what God asks of us in the psalm. Jesus also told the wind and waves to be STILL in a STORM.
lossText: The word was STORM. STILL was the pivot. In Mark 4:39, Jesus calmed a violent STORM on the sea by commanding the wind and waves to be STILL.
votdVerse: He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”
passageText: He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.” The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
